blocks.text: Northwest homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Northwest, September 2026. Detached houses: 30 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 5 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 20%.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 17 sold over 4 months against an average of 28.5 listed, about 6.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 7 sold. Condos and townhomes: 8 sold over 4 months against an average of 6.8 listed, about 3.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 3 sold.

faq.q: How did Northwest Maple Ridge sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 30 active listings, 5 solds and a 17% sales ratio — behind Websters Corners (25%) and Southwest (22%) in the Maple Ridge set — and Condos & Townhomes recorded 5 listings and 1 sold for a 20% ratio, a figure that rests on a very small base and needs that caution attached. Medians are published at community level only (Maple Ridge detached $1,131,000; attached $525,000), and those community figures are not Northwest's own (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Is Northwest Maple Ridge the same as the board's "North" sub-area?
faq.a: No — they are separate rows in the same report. This page maps to "Northwest" (30 detached listings, 5 solds in September 2026); the "North" row recorded 0 listings and 0 solds, and the program's separate north-maple-ridge page does not map cleanly onto it — do not use "North" or "Northeast" figures for this page (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools serve Northwest Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The schools the page names are confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file: Fairview Elementary (12209 206 St) and Laity View Elementary (21023 123 Ave) in Maple Ridge, Westview Secondary (20905 Wicklund Ave), and Davie Jones Elementary (12030 Blakely Rd), which the Ministry file places in Pitt Meadows — catchments are address-based in SD42 and no locator result is on record, so confirm any address with the district (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: How do Northwest Maple Ridge residents commute?
faq.a: Maple Meadows Station serves the city's west side on the West Coast Express, which runs weekday trains between Waterfront (downtown Vancouver) and Mission City, and Haney Place Exchange carries the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus to Coquitlam Central Station; TransLink's Langley–Haney Place BRT is in detailed planning.
